title: Prediction Modules Overview
summary: This module provides a collection of advanced prediction strategies and agentic behaviors for DSPy programs. It includes techniques for iterative refinement, multi-turn tool use, code generation and execution, and aggregation of multiple predictions.

nodes.label: Select Majority Completion
nodes.title: Majority Aggregation
nodes.description: Identifies and returns the most common completion for a specified field from a list of predictions, prioritizing earlier completions in case of ties. Uses a normalization function to process values before comparison.

nodes.label: Normalize Text
nodes.title: Default Normalization
nodes.description: A utility function that normalizes a string, typically for comparison purposes, returning None if the normalized string is empty.

nodes.label: Multi-Turn Tool-Using Agent
nodes.title: Avatar Agent
nodes.description: An agent that iteratively uses a set of tools to accomplish a goal. It reasons about actions, calls tools, and updates its state until the task is finished or max iterations are reached. Leverages a TypedPredictor for action generation.

nodes.label: Actor Signature
nodes.title: Agent Action Signature
nodes.description: Defines the signature for the Avatar agent's decision-making process, specifying inputs like 'goal' and 'tools', and outputs like 'action_1' (tool name and arguments).

nodes.label: Best-of-N Prediction Selection
nodes.title: Best-of-N Module
nodes.description: Executes a given module N times with different rollout IDs and selects the best prediction based on a provided reward function. It can stop early if a prediction meets a specified threshold.

nodes.label: Code Execution Agent
nodes.title: CodeAct Agent
nodes.description: An agent that generates and executes Python code using a PythonInterpreter and a set of predefined tools to solve problems. It iteratively refines code based on execution results until a solution is found or max iterations are reached.

nodes.label: Compare Multiple Reasoning Chains
nodes.title: Multi-Chain Comparison
nodes.description: Compares and synthesizes insights from multiple reasoning attempts (chains of thought) to produce a refined final answer. It takes M completions and generates a consolidated prediction.

nodes.label: Program Generation & Execution
nodes.title: Program of Thought
nodes.description: A module that generates and executes Python programs to solve problems. It iteratively generates code, executes it using a PythonInterpreter, and regenerates code if errors occur, aiming to produce a final output.

nodes.label: Reasoning and Acting Agent
nodes.title: ReAct Agent
nodes.description: Implements the ReAct paradigm, where an LLM interleaves reasoning ('next_thought') and acting ('next_tool_name', 'next_tool_args') to solve tasks. It uses a set of tools and a 'finish' tool to complete the task, handling context window limitations.

nodes.label: Iterative Module Refinement
nodes.title: Refine Module
nodes.description: Enhances a given module by running it multiple times, evaluating its performance with a reward function, and generating feedback to improve subsequent runs. It aims to find the best prediction or one that meets a specified threshold.

nodes.label: Hint Injection Adapter
nodes.title: Wrapper Adapter
nodes.description: A specialized adapter used within the Refine module to inject 'hint' input fields into a module's signature during execution, providing feedback from previous runs to guide the module.

nodes.label: Inspect Module Definitions
nodes.title: Module Inspector
nodes.description: Utility function that generates a formatted string describing the input fields, output fields, and original instructions of all named predictors within a given DSPy program.

nodes.label: Feedback Generation Signature
nodes.title: Offer Feedback Signature
nodes.description: A signature used by the Refine module to generate constructive feedback for individual sub-modules. It takes program details, trajectory, reward, and module names as input, and outputs a discussion of blame and concrete advice.

nodes.label: Recursive Language Model
nodes.title: RLM Module
nodes.description: A module that enables LLMs to programmatically explore large contexts and solve problems by writing and executing Python code within a sandboxed REPL. It supports custom tools and sub-LLM calls, iteratively refining its approach.

nodes.label: Base Module
nodes.title: DSPy Base Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality and structure.

nodes.label: Signature Definition
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields and instructions for a language model call.

nodes.label: Input Field
nodes.title: DSPy Input Field
nodes.description: Represents an input field in a DSPy Signature, specifying its description and type.

nodes.label: Output Field
nodes.title: DSPy Output Field
nodes.description: Represents an output field in a DSPy Signature, specifying its description and type.

nodes.label: Tool Definition
nodes.title: DSPy Tool
nodes.description: A wrapper for functions or callable objects, making them usable by DSPy agents.

nodes.label: Language Model Client
nodes.title: DSPy Language Model
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language model clients integrated with DSPy.

nodes.label: Basic Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy Predict
nodes.description: A fundamental DSPy module that uses a language model to generate predictions based on a signature.

nodes.label: Chain of Thought Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy ChainOfThought
nodes.description: A DSPy module that prompts the language model to generate intermediate reasoning steps before producing the final output.

nodes.label: Prediction Object
nodes.title: DSPy Prediction
nodes.description: A data structure holding the output of a DSPy module's forward pass, including generated fields and metadata.

nodes.label: Python Interpreter
nodes.title: Python Code Interpreter
nodes.description: A sandboxed environment for executing Python code, used by modules like CodeAct, ProgramOfThought, and RLM.

nodes.label: Code Interpreter Interface
nodes.title: DSPy Code Interpreter
nodes.description: An abstract interface for code execution environments, allowing DSPy modules to run arbitrary code.

nodes.label: Typed Predictor
nodes.title: DSPy TypedPredictor
nodes.description: A DSPy module that enforces type constraints on its outputs based on the signature, often used for structured output generation.

groups.label: Agentic Prediction Strategies
groups.title: Agentic Prediction
groups.description: Modules that implement multi-turn, reasoning-and-acting (ReAct) or code-execution (CodeAct, RLM) agentic behaviors to solve complex tasks.

groups.label: Prediction Refinement & Aggregation
groups.title: Refinement & Aggregation
groups.description: Modules focused on improving the quality of predictions through iterative refinement, selection of best-of-N attempts, or aggregation of multiple reasoning chains.

groups.label: Code-Centric Prediction
groups.title: Code-Centric Prediction
groups.description: Modules that leverage code generation and execution as a primary mechanism for problem-solving and prediction.

groups.label: Supporting Components & Utilities
groups.title: Supporting Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions and signatures that provide foundational capabilities or specific functionalities for the main prediction modules.
